Let

\[
A:=p^2-q^2+r^2,\qquad B:=pU-qV+rW.
\]

I claim

\[
\boxed{Z(R)=k[A,B]=k\!\left[p^2-q^2+r^2,\;pU-qV+rW\right].}
\]

Define shifted generators

\[
u=U-p,\qquad v=V-q,\qquad w=W-r.
\]

Then the relations become

\[
[w,u]=2v,\qquad [w,v]=2u,\qquad [u,v]=-2w,
\]

and \(p,q,r\) span an abelian ideal on which \(u,v,w\) act by

\[
[u,p]=0,\quad [u,q]=-2r,\quad [u,r]=-2q,
\]
\[
[v,p]=2r,\quad [v,q]=0,\quad [v,r]=-2p,
\]
\[
[w,p]=2q,\quad [w,q]=2p,\quad [w,r]=0.
\]

Thus \(R\) is the enveloping algebra of the semidirect product
\[
\mathfrak h=\mathfrak{sl}_2\ltimes \mathfrak{sl}_2^{\mathrm{ab}},
\]
where \(p,q,r\) are the adjoint module.

First, \(A\) is central because the above action preserves the quadratic form

\[
p^2-q^2+r^2.
\]

Indeed each of \(u,v,w\), hence also \(U,V,W\), kills \(A\), and \(p,q,r\) commute with it.

Next write

\[
T:=up-vq+wr.
\]

A direct check using the displayed commutators gives

\[
[x,T]=0
\]

for every \(x\in\{u,v,w,p,q,r\}\). Hence \(T\) is central. Since

\[
B=pU-qV+rW
= p(u+p)-q(v+q)+r(w+r)
= T+A,
\]

\(B\) is central as well.

It remains to show these generate the whole center. Filter \(R=U(\mathfrak h)\) by degree. Then \(\operatorname{gr}R\simeq S(\mathfrak h)\), and the leading term of every central element is Poisson-central in \(S(\mathfrak h)\).

The Poisson invariants of \(S(\mathfrak h)=k[u,v,w,p,q,r]\) are exactly

\[
k\left[p^2-q^2+r^2,\;up-vq+wr\right].
\]

Reason: invariance under the abelian ideal \(kp+kq+kr\) forces a polynomial to depend on \(u,v,w\) only through the invariant pairing \(up-vq+wr\), together with \(p,q,r\). Then invariance under the \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\)-part leaves only the quadratic adjoint invariant \(p^2-q^2+r^2\). Hence

\[
S(\mathfrak h)^{\mathfrak h}
=
k[A,\operatorname{gr}B].
\]

Now take any \(z\in Z(R)\). Its highest filtered part is a polynomial in \(A\) and \(\operatorname{gr}B\). Subtract the corresponding polynomial in the actual central elements \(A,B\). This lowers the degree. Repeating by induction shows \(z\in k[A,B]\).

Therefore

\[
\boxed{Z(R)=k\!\left[p^2-q^2+r^2,\;pU-qV+rW\right].}
\]
